raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]As far as I was aware, Rose Riverside was dissolved after your princess fled far away and the Canoes scattered.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: As far as I was aware, Rose Riverside was dissolved after your princess fled far away and the Canoes scattered.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Quite a few former Canoes have gone on to serve the Military Commission.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Quite a few former Canoes have gone on to serve the Military Commission.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Reestablishing our long-lost contact right after the Commission's decline suggests you want something from me. I can't guarantee you'll get it.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Reestablishing our long-lost contact right after the Commission's decline suggests you want something from me. I can't guarantee you'll get it.

raw: [name="Mysterious Vampire"]Not even for old-time's sake? You're the same as ever, Kal'tsit.
speaker: Mysterious Vampire
content: Not even for old-time's sake? You're the same as ever, Kal'tsit.

raw: [name="Mysterious Vampire"]It's hard to believe how much Amiya has grown. No doubt she's keeping an eye on me, yes?
speaker: Mysterious Vampire
content: It's hard to believe how much Amiya has grown. No doubt she's keeping an eye on me, yes?

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: A necessary precaution.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Logos warned us of your appearance.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Since we withdrew from the falling airship, you are the first outsider to reach our safe house.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Since we withdrew from the falling airship, you are the first outsider to reach our safe house.

speaker: Mysterious Vampire
content: ...'Outsider'.

raw: [name="Mysterious Vampire"]Are you like me, Dame Kal'tsit—most difficult to persuade when we're in the throes of grief?
speaker: Mysterious Vampire
content: Are you like me, Dame Kal'tsit—most difficult to persuade when we're in the throes of grief?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]This is not a Babel safe house, Entelechia.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: This is not a Babel safe house, Entelechia.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]Hearing that codename coming from your lips truly takes me back.
speaker: Entelechia
content: Hearing that codename coming from your lips truly takes me back.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]I passed by the charnel house that is Londinium on my way here. I rescued a few fortunate souls, and sent off a few unfortunate ones.
speaker: Entelechia
content: I passed by the charnel house that is Londinium on my way here. I rescued a few fortunate souls, and sent off a few unfortunate ones.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]It brings me no joy to see my countrymen spill their blood on foreign soil, Kal'tsit.
speaker: Entelechia
content: It brings me no joy to see my countrymen spill their blood on foreign soil, Kal'tsit.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]I don't recall you being such a sentimental person.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I don't recall you being such a sentimental person.

raw: The Vampire goes silent. Kal'tsit sees she has no intention of answering.
content: The Vampire goes silent. Kal'tsit sees she has no intention of answering.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Why would you risk crossing the battlefields of Victoria to see me, Entelechia?
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Why would you risk crossing the battlefields of Victoria to see me, Entelechia?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]If you require assistance, Theresis would be the better option.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: If you require assistance, Theresis would be the better option.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]No need for these probing questions, Kal'tsit. I'd rather not have anything to do with the Regent. Perhaps some of the sisters agree with him, but as you know...
speaker: Entelechia
content: No need for these probing questions, Kal'tsit. I'd rather not have anything to do with the Regent. Perhaps some of the sisters agree with him, but as you know...

raw: [name="Entelechia"]Ever since Her Highness Theresa's untimely accident at Babel, there has been less and less contact between us. Our sororal bonds have weakened.
speaker: Entelechia
content: Ever since Her Highness Theresa's untimely accident at Babel, there has been less and less contact between us. Our sororal bonds have weakened.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]But that is not why I came to find you, Kal'tsit. I intend to help Ascalon with a trifling matter, one that will allow her to enter the city a tad easier.
speaker: Entelechia
content: But that is not why I came to find you, Kal'tsit. I intend to help Ascalon with a trifling matter, one that will allow her to enter the city a tad easier.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: What do you want?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]According to our latest intelligence, the Military Commission is strengthening its control within the city.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: According to our latest intelligence, the Military Commission is strengthening its control within the city.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]The Nachzehrer troops and the ducal armies are facing each other down at the city walls. The situation is ever-changing.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: The Nachzehrer troops and the ducal armies are facing each other down at the city walls. The situation is ever-changing.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]Oh, I know, I know. But such an adorable and studious youngster as her is well worth the effort to look after.
speaker: Entelechia
content: Oh, I know, I know. But such an adorable and studious youngster as her is well worth the effort to look after.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]That is not what I mean. Given the circumstances, you should have been unable to find any trace of Ascalon. I am very familiar with her ways.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: That is not what I mean. Given the circumstances, you should have been unable to find any trace of Ascalon. I am very familiar with her ways.

speaker: Entelechia
content: She is wounded. Gravely so.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]She's never used something like that as an excuse to lower her guard.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: She's never used something like that as an excuse to lower her guard.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]You really trust her. It's hard to say whether I should be happy or worried for her that you hold her in such high regard.
speaker: Entelechia
content: You really trust her. It's hard to say whether I should be happy or worried for her that you hold her in such high regard.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Who is helping you with this?

raw: [name="Entelechia"]Trickster, one of our sharp-eyed sisters. As a technician, she was able to hunt down a few clues I was looking for in Londinium.
speaker: Entelechia
content: Trickster, one of our sharp-eyed sisters. As a technician, she was able to hunt down a few clues I was looking for in Londinium.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Her? I remember you all cherished her and would never have approved of putting her in the middle of this battle. And according to the vows made by all you Canoes, none of you should even be here.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Her? I remember you all cherished her and would never have approved of putting her in the middle of this battle. And according to the vows made by all you Canoes, none of you should even be here.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]...As I suspected, you know of our plight. Her intelligence was right. You have a trail leading to the princess.
speaker: Entelechia
content: ...As I suspected, you know of our plight. Her intelligence was right. You have a trail leading to the princess.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]As I'm sure you're well aware, Dame, I am the only one who will not and can not leave this river of blood.
speaker: Entelechia
content: As I'm sure you're well aware, Dame, I am the only one who will not and can not leave this river of blood.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]Do you still doubt me, even after all I said?
speaker: Entelechia
content: Do you still doubt me, even after all I said?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Rhodes Island thanks you for your assistance. We will repay the Canoes in kind, just as Theresa did during the Babel years.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Rhodes Island thanks you for your assistance. We will repay the Canoes in kind, just as Theresa did during the Babel years.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]I will tell you all I know in regard to that princess.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I will tell you all I know in regard to that princess.

speaker: Entelechia
content: Thank you, Kal'tsit.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]On another note, while I was in the bowels of the city, I caught a whiff of Duq'arael's stench. While I would love to help settle that matter for you while I'm there—
speaker: Entelechia
content: On another note, while I was in the bowels of the city, I caught a whiff of Duq'arael's stench. While I would love to help settle that matter for you while I'm there—

raw: [name="Entelechia"]I will need help from your people.
speaker: Entelechia
content: I will need help from your people.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]I'm afraid Rhodes Island does not have any more to spare inside the city.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I'm afraid Rhodes Island does not have any more to spare inside the city.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]There is a local faction known as Millscar. Finding them should not be a challenge for you.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: There is a local faction known as Millscar. Finding them should not be a challenge for you.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]They are close to the heart of the storm, but are determined to avoid entangling themselves with any of the involved parties. A stance you would find familiar, I'm sure.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: They are close to the heart of the storm, but are determined to avoid entangling themselves with any of the involved parties. A stance you would find familiar, I'm sure.

speaker: Entelechia
content: You would trust someone like that?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]We retain shared interests, for the time being.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: We retain shared interests, for the time being.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]If the Military Commission has other plans for Duq'arael's arrangements, they will undoubtedly affect the ducal alliance's next moves... or even disrupt the Exemplars' plans to enter the city.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: If the Military Commission has other plans for Duq'arael's arrangements, they will undoubtedly affect the ducal alliance's next moves... or even disrupt the Exemplars' plans to enter the city.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Neither Rhodes Island nor Millscar wishes to see such an outcome.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Neither Rhodes Island nor Millscar wishes to see such an outcome.

speaker: Entelechia
content: Haha. You really haven't changed one bit. Did this plan come from you, or that commander of yours?

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: It is Rhodes Island's plan.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]...Rhodes Island. Very well, do send my regards to your commander. Though I fear I'm simply another lost memory at this point.
speaker: Entelechia
content: ...Rhodes Island. Very well, do send my regards to your commander. Though I fear I'm simply another lost memory at this point.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]Dame, there is a question that's been eating away at me, one I was hoping you could answer.
speaker: Entelechia
content: Dame, there is a question that's been eating away at me, one I was hoping you could answer.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]Aside from His Highness the Regent, I'm afraid only you hold the answer. After all, you were the only ones who made it from the airship.
speaker: Entelechia
content: Aside from His Highness the Regent, I'm afraid only you hold the answer. After all, you were the only ones who made it from the airship.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Is a question you already know the answer to really so important?
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Is a question you already know the answer to really so important?

speaker: Entelechia
content: ...Of course it is.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]If one does not see it with one's own eyes, hear it with one's own ears, say it with one's own mouth, then saying goodbye becomes quite a challenge.
speaker: Entelechia
content: If one does not see it with one's own eyes, hear it with one's own ears, say it with one's own mouth, then saying goodbye becomes quite a challenge.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]Even though my heart sensed the echo of the myriad souls as they left with such clarity, I still ask myself over and over if she was among them.
speaker: Entelechia
content: Even though my heart sensed the echo of the myriad souls as they left with such clarity, I still ask myself over and over if she was among them.

content: And so I must ask... Has Her Highness left us once more?

content: Her Highness has only just left us, and those who have hidden in the shadows for too long are only too eager to act.

content: You played your part well, though. Otherwise, it would have been such a bother finding an excuse to let him go.

content: Don't misunderstand me. Her Highness is dead, and I have no intention of following the Regent to throw my life away in Victoria.

content: It almost sounds like you want to kill me too, Milton.

content: Hah.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]The situation is rather murky at the moment, and the sisters have scattered. Even I am having trouble tracking them down.

content: The situation is rather murky at the moment, and the sisters have scattered. Even I am having trouble tracking them down.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]The chaos in Kazdel has forced me to bid many a farewell. There are fewer and fewer informants I can speak to as the days go by.
speaker: Entelechia
content: The chaos in Kazdel has forced me to bid many a farewell. There are fewer and fewer informants I can speak to as the days go by.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]I do not intend on losing another sister because of you.

content: I do not intend on losing another sister because of you.

raw: [name="Milton"]...There's nowhere any of you can hide.

content: ...There's nowhere any of you can hide.

raw: [name="Milton"]Most of the people after you aren't doing it out of hatred, but for the information you have.

content: Most of the people after you aren't doing it out of hatred, but for the information you have.

raw: [name="Milton"]Even if the Military Commission says they won't hunt down anyone with ties to Babel, do you really think they'd let you waltz away with all those secrets spilling out of your pockets?

content: Even if the Military Commission says they won't hunt down anyone with ties to Babel, do you really think they'd let you waltz away with all those secrets spilling out of your pockets?

content: Hmph.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]I'd like to see them try and stop me.
speaker: Entelechia
content: I'd like to see them try and stop me.

speaker: Entelechia
content: You're on a fool's errand, Milton.

raw: [name="Milton"]I'm just a worthless merc, but if I really do manage to bring your head in, at least I'll have a chance to protect my sister.

content: I'm just a worthless merc, but if I really do manage to bring your head in, at least I'll have a chance to protect my sister.

content: Tch.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]You could have been more honest from the start.

content: You could have been more honest from the start.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]If I promise you that none living shall approach this street, will you speak with candor?

raw: [name="Entelechia"]Yes, exactly what you're thinking. Your friends in ambush will not be coming.

content: Yes, exactly what you're thinking. Your friends in ambush will not be coming.

raw: [name="Milton"]You're not as calm as you're pretending to be either.

content: You're not as calm as you're pretending to be either.

raw: [name="Milton"]You pretend your pursuers bother you and claim you acted only to expose a traitor.
speaker: Milton
content: You pretend your pursuers bother you and claim you acted only to expose a traitor.

raw: [name="Milton"]Then you send everyone who finds you back to reveal your location, all so that anyone with a grudge against the Canoes will focus solely on you.

content: Then you send everyone who finds you back to reveal your location, all so that anyone with a grudge against the Canoes will focus solely on you.

content: I heard from my sister that you were the one who cleaned up after every operation. The cleaner, they call you.

content: Once when she barely escaped by the skin of her teeth, you used a similar method to draw attention to yourself.

content: ...And what makes you say that?

speaker: Entelechia
content: Kal'tsit, she may have simply come to say farewell to Her Highness... Or perhaps it was to stop Trickster and I from continuing our search...

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]The sudden disappearance of your princess on the eve of Babel's collapse is suspicious enough. I cannot even confirm if she left on Theresa's orders.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: The sudden disappearance of your princess on the eve of Babel's collapse is suspicious enough. I cannot even confirm if she left on Theresa's orders.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Until we know where she truly stands, Rhodes Island cannot rule out the possibility that she might interfere with our plans.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Until we know where she truly stands, Rhodes Island cannot rule out the possibility that she might interfere with our plans.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Even if I too wish to believe that she has simply come to say her goodbyes.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Even if I too wish to believe that she has simply come to say her goodbyes.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]I will find her, Kal'tsit. The final clues Trickster left for me will be enough.
speaker: Entelechia
content: I will find her, Kal'tsit. The final clues Trickster left for me will be enough.

speaker: Entelechia
content: She owes me an answer, too.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]If you need assistance, we are still happy to—
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: If you need assistance, we are still happy to—

raw: [name="Entelechia"]I know you are going to say that Rhodes Island wants to help.
speaker: Entelechia
content: I know you are going to say that Rhodes Island wants to help.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]But Rhodes Island and Babel are very different beasts. I do not wish for Rhodes Island to be ensnared in the past once again. I believe Her Highness would not want it either.
speaker: Entelechia
content: But Rhodes Island and Babel are very different beasts. I do not wish for Rhodes Island to be ensnared in the past once again. I believe Her Highness would not want it either.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Our name may have changed, Entelechia, but our mission hasn't.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Our name may have changed, Entelechia, but our mission hasn't.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Rhodes Island will not continue down Babel's doomed path, but we will never deny the ideals Babel showed us.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Rhodes Island will not continue down Babel's doomed path, but we will never deny the ideals Babel showed us.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Besides, I want the truth too.

speaker: Entelechia
content: ...I thank you for your kindness.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]A drifting canoe needs its berth, and for us, that can only be Kazdel...
speaker: Entelechia
content: A drifting canoe needs its berth, and for us, that can only be Kazdel...

raw: [name="Entelechia"]The Royal Court, shaped by Duq'arael, reeks with a stench that displeases the sisters. No doubt, sooner or later, another vile creature will emerge from his pool of blood.
speaker: Entelechia
content: The Royal Court, shaped by Duq'arael, reeks with a stench that displeases the sisters. No doubt, sooner or later, another vile creature will emerge from his pool of blood.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]Perhaps I will rope in some other Canoes in due time, to cross the river of blood once more, and return to the city Her Highness built.
speaker: Entelechia
content: Perhaps I will rope in some other Canoes in due time, to cross the river of blood once more, and return to the city Her Highness built.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]I foresee Kazdel having even greater need of us in the wake of this war than Babel ever did.
speaker: Entelechia
content: I foresee Kazdel having even greater need of us in the wake of this war than Babel ever did.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]I fear persuading those sisters of yours will not be easy. Not to mention your drifter of a princess.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I fear persuading those sisters of yours will not be easy. Not to mention your drifter of a princess.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]I believe in the vows of us Canoes, even if many of us detest each other.
speaker: Entelechia
content: I believe in the vows of us Canoes, even if many of us detest each other.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]Send this petal of Trickster's to Kazdel in my stead, Dame. See her home.
speaker: Entelechia
content: Send this petal of Trickster's to Kazdel in my stead, Dame. See her home.

raw: She slowly opens her hand, revealing a sparkling, blood-red crystal. She did all she could to preserve the longing lingering in her sister's veins.
content: She slowly opens her hand, revealing a sparkling, blood-red crystal. She did all she could to preserve the longing lingering in her sister's veins.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]You have my promise, and Rhodes Island's as well.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: You have my promise, and Rhodes Island's as well.

raw: [name="Entelechia"]Then don't blame me when trouble comes knocking on your door.
speaker: Entelechia
content: Then don't blame me when trouble comes knocking on your door.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]It has been a long time since Rhodes Island was as weak as you imagine, Entelechia.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: It has been a long time since Rhodes Island was as weak as you imagine, Entelechia.

speaker: Entelechia
content: We can only hope. Goodbye, Kal'tsit.
